Pool & Spa Automation

Total pool and spa control from any phone, tablet, or computer anywhere in the world with an internet connection

Total Pool Control At Your Fingertips

Pool/ Spa Automation allows for complete control of your pool from anywhere in the world with an internet connection. Control your pumps, heaters, salt systems, lights, water features and more without going to the pool equipment pad.

Headed home from a long day at work and thinking of going for a swim? Simply set your desired pool temperature on our mobile app and have your pool at temperature ready for a swim when you get home... One of the many benefits of pool/spa automation.

Benefits Of Pool/Spa Automation

Pool and spa automation makes for a more enjoyable and technologically advanced swimming experience.
Pool Operation SimplifiedControl all your pool equipment, including pumps, heaters, salt systems, lights, and more in one place
Ultimate FlexibilityAllow multiple users access to the mobile app and your pool professional remote access for diagnostic issues.
Ease Of Operation

With pool/spa automation you'll reduce trips to your pool equipment area for simple pool changes.

It's Kinda CoolHonestly, it's just plain cool. Who wouldn't want to control their swim experience from their phone.

Upgrade your swimming pool experience with cutting-edge pool and spa automation systems. Benefit from simplified operation, reduced trips to the equipment area, and remote control through a convenient phone app.
